summary: Riskified Ltd. filed Form 6-K on May 13, 2026, announcing its Q1 2026 financial results and raising revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance. The filing includes a press release with GAAP financial statements and details a share repurchase program (6.2 million shares for $27.5 million, avg. $4.44/share). No M&A, tender, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings report with no event triggering a special-situations classification. The share buyback is ordinary-course, not a formal issuer tender offer requiring Schedules TO-I or 13E-3.
